description: Derived extractions for Microsoft Defender (winlog.channel == 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational'), projected to ECS. Detection and remediation events (1006/1007/1015/1116/1117/1118/1119) classify as malware; the Defender EventData names carry spaces, so they are read as winlog.data['Threat Name'] etc. Projects rule.name (the threat/signature), file.path (the detected object), process.executable, and user from 'Detection User'. The native winlog.data.* stays in place.

script.description: event.category/type/outcome for Defender detection and remediation events
script.source: def id = ctx.winlog.event_id; def detect = ['1006','1015','1116','1118','1119']; def action = ['1007','1117']; if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } if (detect.contains(id)) { if (ctx.event.category == null) { ctx.event.category = 'malware'; } if (ctx.event.type == null) { ctx.event.type = 'info'; } } else if (action.contains(id)) { if (ctx.event.category == null) { ctx.event.category = 'malware'; } if (ctx.event.type == null) { ctx.event.type = 'info'; } if (ctx.event.outcome == null) { ctx.event.outcome = 'success'; } }

script.description: project Defender EventData (space-named) onto ECS rule.name / file.path / process.executable / user
script.source: boolean real(def v) { return v instanceof String && v.length() > 0 && v != '-'; } void put(def root, List path, def v) { if (!real(v)) { return; } def cur = root; for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) { if (!(cur[path[i]] instanceof Map)) { cur[path[i]] = [:]; } cur = cur[path[i]]; } if (cur[path[path.size() - 1]] == null) { cur[path[path.size() - 1]] = v; } } void setuser(def root, def v) { if (!(v instanceof String) || v.length() == 0 || v == '-') { return; } int ix = v.lastIndexOf(Character.toString((char)92)); if (ix >= 0) { put(root, ['user','domain'], v.substring(0, ix)); put(root, ['user','name'], v.substring(ix + 1)); } else { put(root, ['user','name'], v); } } def d = ctx.winlog.data; put(ctx, ['rule','name'], d['Threat Name']); put(ctx, ['file','path'], d['Path']); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d['Process Name']); setuser(ctx, d['Detection User']);
